A departmental label does not by itself raise its holder into the Council or expand a native permission. The [Olympus Role & Rank Rosetta Stone](#/roles/rosetta-stone) is the common bridge to the [current stable-office and assignable-key register](#/organization), [application tracks](#/vote) and attended [rank planner](#/admin/ranks).
